metadata.title: USGS 3DEP bare-earth elevation — Los Angeles Harbor coastal crop
metadata.source: USGS 3DEP Elevation ImageServer (regional multi-resolution DEM; NOAA regional topo-bathy land mask)
metadata.acquisition_note: USGS 3DEP source mosaics are multi-resolution; this 2304×1500 EPSG:4326 display crop is resampled (~4.8 m), not a claim of native 5 m source accuracy.
metadata.imagery_source: USGS National Map NAIP Imagery ImageServer; imagery is an orthophoto mosaic, not live video.
metadata.imagery_date_note: Image service copyright date: January 09, 2025; underlying acquisition dates vary by location.
metadata.imagery_grid: 3072×1668 RGB orthophoto with independent imagery_bounds, geographically draped over the land-only mesh using pixel-centre coordinates. Display pixels are not a claim of source ground accuracy.
metadata.vertical_alignment: NAVD88 values displayed with zero offset against the MLLW display water reference; datum transformation has not been applied. Regional fill also retains its source datum.
